mgmt_recent.text: On November 6, 2025, Lilly named two new Executive Committee members: Carole Ho, who joined as executive vice president and president of Lilly Neuroscience, and Adrienne Brown, promoted from group vice president of corporate business development to executive vice president and president of Lilly Immunology. Daniel Skovronsky took an expanded role as chief scientific and product officer and president of Lilly Research Laboratories, while Jacob Van Naarden, president of Lilly Oncology, added corporate business development. Chair and CEO David A. Ricks framed the changes as backing expansion plans in neuroscience and immunology.

sentences.text: Dave Ricks, a Lilly veteran since 1996, became chief executive in January 2017 and was elected board chair effective June 2017, a combined chair-CEO structure that some governance observers view as a weakness.

Capital allocation tilts to reinvestment, with capital expenditures of $7.8 billion in 2025 versus $5.1 billion in 2024, alongside $4.0 billion of buybacks and $3.1 billion of dividends in the first half of 2026.
